For weight vector v, PBW reordering in three generators follows directly from [h,e]=2e,[h,f]=-2f,[e,f]=h and spans U(sl2)v by f^a e^b v. There are finitely many b by e nilpotence, and then finitely many a for each e^b v by f nilpotence. Finite sums of weight vectors give local finiteness. Conversely finite invariant cyclic spaces have finitely many h eigenvalues inherited from a weight module; e,f shift by ±2, so long enough powers vanish. No appeal to unavailable finite-dimensional complete reducibility is needed.
